title: clean
body:
## clean

Cleans polygonal data: merges duplicate points within a tolerance, removes unused points and turns degenerate cells into lower-dimensional ones (a triangle with two merged points becomes a line). Output is polydata. Use it after appendGeometry or on surfaces with duplicated vertices to get a connected surface for normals, curvature, connectivity or decimation. For other dataset types use cleanGrid.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A large tolerance collapses small features and can change topology; keep it well below the smallest edge length.

Native constructor: `Clean`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mergePoints` | If this property is set to 1, then points will be merged if they are within the specified Tolerance or AbsoluteTolerance (see the Tolerance and AbsoluteTolerance properties), depending on the value of the ToleranceIsAbsolute property. (See the ToleranceIsAbsolute property.) If this property is set to 0, points will not be merged. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `tolerance` | If merging nearby points (see PointMerging property) and not using absolute tolerance (see ToleranceIsAbsolute property), this property specifies the tolerance for performing merging as a fraction of the length of the diagonal of the bounding box of the input data set. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0}` | `0` | `0` |
| `absolute` | This property determines whether to use absolute or relative (a percentage of the bounding box) tolerance when performing point merging. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |
| `absoluteTolerance` | If merging nearby points (see PointMerging property) and using absolute tolerance (see ToleranceIsAbsolute property), this property specifies the tolerance for performing merging in the spatial units of the input data set. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0}` | `0` | `0` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "clean",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
